messages:
maria: FYI opened a small docs PR to add a reproducible detect-and-shorten snippet + brief retry guidance (node/python/curl). wanted to sync on wording and CI requirements before finalizing.

sam: nice. can you paste the proposed snippets here so i can sanity-check the lint rules?

maria: sure. node snippet (using fetch) + quick curl to show header; python requests + a tiny pytest to assert header-driven fallback. plan to label it as an operational troubleshooting example.

kevin: i can write the python snippet and the pytest fixture. question: what header name should we show in examples? we probably shouldn't hardcode a vendor header.

maria: good point. i'm going to phrase it as "inspect service metadata header (e.g. x-rw-context-trim)" and explicitly note "vendor header names may differ". keeps it neutral.

liz: please add a one-liner on tradeoffs: prefer detect-and-shorten when you want to preserve quality on most requests but gracefully handle occasional trims; prefer proactive trimming for strict latency budgets.

sam: also add a tiny reproducible curl flow that people can run locally to trigger the trim header in our test harness. that makes the snippet actionable.

maria: agreed. i'll add a curl example and a sample big_prompt.json. quick curl: ```bash
curl -i -X POST $RW_URL -d @big_prompt.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer $RW_KEY\"
# look for: x-rw-context-trim: true in response headers
```

kevin: for python i'll include: requests.post, check resp.headers.get('x-rw-context-trim'), if present then shorten system prompt and retry with exponential backoff. plus a pytest that mocks Response.headers.

sam: i can take the node linting pass. the snippets CI was complaining yesterday about fence language and trailing whitespace; i'll run them through snippet-lint locally.

docs-bot: PR #431 opened by maria 022 reviewers requested: @sam @kevin; labels: docs-snippet, needs-ci.

ci-bot: snippet-lint failed for PR #431: fenced code lang should be "javascript" not "js"; trailing whitespace in codeblock; tests: snippet-lint-1 failing.

maria: fixing fence tags and trimming trailing spaces now. i'll also rename the heading to "Detect-and-shorten: quick troubleshooting pattern" so it matches cross-links.

liz: editorial nit: use "detect-and-shorten" lowercase and hyphenated across docs for consistency with errref. add a short flow (bullet) showing: detect -> shorten system prompt -> retry -> fallback to smaller model.

kevin: once the tidied snippets are in i'll add the pytest and a tiny fixture that simulates a long prompt response with the header. i'll open a follow-up PR for tests if you want to keep the changelist small.

sam: after CI is green i'll do a quick content review. should be a fast merge.

maria: thanks all 10: pushing the lint fixes and the curl example now. tagging @liz for final copyedit once CI passes.

liz: will copyedit on green. small ask: include a single-sentence link to the 429/timeouts errref and to the SDK retry guidance page.

maria: will add both links. thanks team :thumbsup:
